definitions.short: a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz
definitions.full: H7074. Qenizzi קְנִזִּי adjective, of a people , with article ׳הַקּ , of Caleb Num 32:12 ; Josh 14:6 , 14 (all J E); as n.collective Gen 15:19 (in list; apparently South Canaanitish people). קֵנִי see קֵינִי . p 884
